name: Hadid
overview: Hadid is identified in Scripture as a city within the territory of Benjamin, notable for its inhabitants who were among the captives returning from Babylonian exile. The books of Ezra and Nehemiah record the children of Hadid alongside those of Lod and Ono, numbering over seven hundred individuals who returned to their homeland. This highlights Hadid's role as a restored community in the post-exilic period, emphasizing God's faithfulness in bringing His people back to their ancestral cities.
